description: Source code for persistence utilities in telemetry component, including config file handling, cached report management, and privacy mode settings.

methods.name: persistReportMethodInit
methods.description: Initializes the mutex for cached report persistence.

methods.name: fetchLocalConfigs
methods.description: Reads configuration files from a specified directory into a list.

methods.name: saveConfigToFile
methods.description: Saves a configuration string to a specified file.

methods.name: MsgPackSaveConfig
methods.description: Saves a MsgPack blob to a specified file.

methods.name: clearPersistenceFolder
methods.description: Removes all files in a specified folder.

methods.name: removeProfileFromDisk
methods.description: Deletes a specific profile file from disk.

methods.name: saveCachedReportToPersistenceFolder
methods.description: Saves a list of reports to a cache file associated with a profile.

methods.name: populateCachedReportList
methods.description: Loads cached reports from disk into a list and deletes the cache file.

methods.name: setPrivacyMode
methods.description: Sets privacy mode and saves it persistently.

methods.name: savePrivacyModeToPersistentFolder
methods.description: Saves privacy mode data to a persistent file.
